research_question: What is the effect of fibrin-based haemostatic agents compared with non-fibrin haemostatic agents or techniques on perioperative mortality in adults undergoing liver resection?
outcome_description: Number of participants who died from any cause during the perioperative period (in-hospital or within 30 to 90 days postoperatively) out of the total randomised participants (intention-to-treat denominator)
positive_direction: A risk ratio greater than 1.0 (positive effect on log scale) indicates higher perioperative mortality with fibrin-based haemostatic agents compared to non-fibrin comparators
search_queries: fibrin sealant liver resection randomized trial mortality
fibrin glue hepatic resection trial haemostasis comparison
fibrin patch liver surgery controlled trial mortality death
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trials in adult patients undergoing liver resection
Comparison of a fibrin-based haemostatic agent (sealant, glue, patch, or coated collagen) with a non-fibrin haemostatic agent or standard surgical technique
Reporting of perioperative mortality (in-hospital or 30 to 90 days post-surgery) with number of events and arm sample sizes
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical randomised controlled trial (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, observational studies, letters, and editorials excluded)
Comparison does not contrast a fibrin-based agent with a non-fibrin haemostatic comparator (e.g. fibrin vs no haemostat, or comparison between two fibrin agents)
No perioperative mortality data reported (studies omitting mortality reporting entirely are excluded, whereas trials explicitly reporting zero deaths are retained)
Study population does not involve adults undergoing liver (hepatic) resection
moderators_to_extract: Type of fibrin-based agent (sealant/liquid vs patch/matrix)
Type of comparator haemostatic technique (topical agent vs energy device vs standard surgical haemostasis)
Extent of liver resection (major vs minor resection)
Definition of perioperative mortality follow-up duration (in-hospital, 30 days, 90 days)
effect_size_note: Risk ratio (RR) of perioperative mortality (events fibrin / total randomised fibrin vs events control / total randomised control) pooled with a random-effects model. Multi-arm trials with multiple non-fibrin comparator arms are combined into a single control group. Trials reporting zero events in one arm are included with continuity correction.
